disposition_reason: Prints mean and SD of cadmium, lead and mercury in milk of 10 organically kept goats at four lactation stages.

study.design: longitudinal on-farm study, 10 French Alpine goats in fourth lactation, milk sampled on lactation days 30, 60, 90, 120 during winter feeding
study.origin: family organic goat farm, Slavonia, Croatia (45°43' N, 17°51' E)
study.period_text: winter-feeding season (1 October to 1 March); year not stated
study.method: microwave digestion (HNO3/H2SO4/H2O2); Cd and Pb by electrothermal AAS (Perkin Elmer 4100 ZL), Hg by hydride/cold-vapour AAS (Perkin Elmer 2380, MHS-10)
study.qa: no CRM, recovery or LOD reported
